features: My First Script Kinda Random Ngl
script:
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()

local Window = Library.CreateLib("Sigma Boy Gui v.1.1", "BloodTheme")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("Home")

local Tab = Window:NewTab("Player Physics")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Physics")
Section:NewSlider("WalkSpeed", "Increase and decrease your walkspeed.", 500, 0, function(s) -- 500 (MaxValue) | 0 (MinValue)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = s
end)
Section:NewSlider("Jump Power", "Increase and decrease your jump power.", 500, 0, function(s) -- 500 (MaxValue) | 0 (MinValue)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = s
end)
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Others")
Section:NewButton("Infinite Jump", "Removes Jump Delay.", function()
    local InfiniteJumpEnabled = true
game:GetService("UserInputService").JumpRequest:connect(function()
	if InfiniteJumpEnabled then
		game:GetService"Players".LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass'Humanoid':ChangeState("Jumping")
	end
end)
end)
Section:NewButton("Click TP (Q) ( click on the tp button first)", "Click to teleport using q on your keyboard.", function()
    plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer

hum = plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart

mouse = plr:GetMouse()



mouse.KeyDown:connect(function(key)

if key == "q" then

if mouse.Target then

hum.CFrame = CFrame.new(mouse.Hit.x, mouse.Hit.y + 5, mouse.Hit.z)

end

end
end)
end)
Section:NewButton("Noclip (E) ( click on noclip button first)", "Noclip through walls by pressing Q", function()
    noclip = false
game:GetService('RunService').Stepped:Connect(function()
	if noclip then
		game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(11)
		
	end
end)

local p = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local mo = p:GetMouse()

mo.KeyDown:Connect(function(k)
	if k == 'e' then
		noclip = not noclip
		p.Character.Humanoid:ChangeState(11)
	end
end)
end)

comments.text: Also, I forgot to mention this, but this script is pretty good for a starter. Considering you know how to change the walkspeed, jumppower, do inf jumps, teleport, and noclip!
